video:video.video:title: A Doctor Warns: Stop Reading Your Own Lab Results Using AI | Dr. Steven Labkoff
video:video.video:description: Dr. Steven Labkoff explains why using general-purpose AI to interpret personal lab results can produce confident but clinically dangerous conclusions and why healthcare AI literacy matters.

video:video.video:title: Don't Upload Your Medical Record to ChatGPT — Here's Why
video:video.video:description: Dr. Terry Adirim explains why patients should never upload a complete medical record to a general-purpose LLM and how to use AI health information safely.

video:video.video:title: The AI Governance Problem Nobody's Talking About
video:video.video:description: Ethan Seib explains where unsupervised AI agents fail, how operational governance works, and which business decisions must remain human-controlled.

video:video.video:title: The Addiction Treatment Crisis No One's Talking About
video:video.video:description: David Sichel explains why a missed 3 AM addiction-treatment call can be a patient-safety event and how responsible AI can support a safe human handoff.

video:video.video:title: AI in Healthcare: The Hidden Reason It's Not Scaling
video:video.video:description: Dr. Angel Mena explains why hospital AI pilots fail to scale and what clinical, operational, legal, and governance leaders must settle first.

video:video.video:title: Why AI Agents Are Healthcare's Biggest Security Risk
video:video.video:description: Pranava Adduri explains how autonomous AI agents enlarge healthcare security risk, permission drift, and the potential blast radius of a breach.
